children: Canada spirits and wine maker's Q1 organic revenue rose 1% as RTD growth offset spirits softness
Adjusted EPS for Q1 rose yr/yr; adjusted net income also up
Company maintained quarterly dividend at C$0.25 per share
Corby expects the spirits market to remain uncertain and volatile for the foreseeable future
Company says it will maintain disciplined cost management and invest behind strategic priorities
RTD GROWTH - Continued growth in ready-to-drink brands, supported by pricing gains in Ontario and Alberta, offset softness in spirits
HIGHER COMMISSIONS - Increase in commission revenue from new and expanded agreements helped boost overall revenue
COST DISCIPLINE - Lower marketing and overhead expenses, along with supply chain efficiencies, supported margin improvement
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the distillers & wineries peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Corby Spirit and Wine Ltd is C$22.00, about 38.3% above its November 10 closing price of C$15.91
The stock recently traded at 14 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 14 three months ago
